profile.headline: Software Engineer at Hewlett-Packard
profile.summary: Electrical Engineer Bachelor of Science from University of California, San Diego (UCSD)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: 16399 Bernardo Center Dr San Diego, CA 92127
positions.description:
•	Lead engineer on two programs and organization owner of GitHub repositories.
	--Throughput, Antenna, Noise floor, and Connection Times (TANC) is an cross platform GUI program built in Python 2.7 with pyQT which interfaced the device under test (DUT) with a router, attenuator, APC PDU, and host computer (linux/Windows) to assist engineers in design. The program outputted data to help determine the optimal PCB schematic layout, performance data of the wifi module, and test multiple network configurations for the DUT.
	--Wireless Easy Chamber One is a framework that tested multiple wireless discovery and onboarding methods that our product supported, E.G. WS-Discovery, Bonjour, and proprietary wireless specifications. New DUTs would be cycled into the chamber and be tested with python scripts. In additional the entire wireless environment was controlled from Ixia IxVeriWave WaveBlade to simulate any environment of our choosing.
•	High priority network issues which involved analysis and debugging with networking applications such as wireshark/tcpdump, scapy, nmap, mitmproxy/fiddler. Strong research abilities in RFC, IETF, IEEE, bluetooth SIG documentation, Wifi-Alliance specifications.
•	Investigations of alternate solutions that require research of APIs capabilities and compatibilities, creating a proof of concept including 802.1x, captive portals, Wi-Fi Aware (NAN), and Bluetooth, and sending out a summarized report.
•	Performance debugging for our mobile app on iOS and android. Used Instruments (xcode) for iOS and android studio to analyze memory, network traffic and view log data.
•	Interviewed potential candidates for our growing team.

positions.title: Net Centric Test and Evaluation Lab Project
positions.description:
- Built custom target operating environment with Red Hat Linux and executed functionality tests of Joint Enterprise Network Manager (JENM) version 1.2.X , 2.5.X and 2.6.X; this also included porting and specifying the configuration to enable JENM to run on virtual machines running VMWare Workstation 9 and 10 on the Joint Tactical Networking Environment NetOps Toolkit (J-TNT).
- Edited bash shell scripts and modified/verified permission attributes for OS security hardening. Updated product code with Eclipse IDE to trunk in Subversion revision control to satisfy information assurance requirements issued by NSA to receive approval from Office of Designated Approval Authority.
- Performed testing of the data assembly and validated the Planning and Engineer Services (PES) software application; this included SQL database and XML schema verification for Network Data Files (NDF) and XML data files.
- Loaded, tested, and performed verification for radio configuration files (RCF) for the following radios: AN/PRC-117G, AN/PRC-152A, AN/PRC-154, and AN/PRC-155.

positions.title: IT helpdesk
positions.description:
-	Tracked and issued out company assets by updating information in the MS Access database and prepared purchase requisitions and created proposals for new equipment purchases.
-	Repaired and troubleshot hardware and RMA handling, assisted employees with software issues on Macs and PCs.
-	Active directory management of company’s computers, allocated network IPs along with organizing the switch room for efficient networking. Set up faxes, PCs, network scanners, network printers onto specific subnets.
- Assisted in interviewing and hiring new student employees for helpdesk position.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Designed Virtual Instruments (VIs) using labVIEW.
- Designed an application for data communication between the UUT, PC, and a pressure
tank.
- Updated past designs using SolidWorks
- Special project: used SolidWorks to design a specific table and created it for company use
- Trial tested their new software that they installed in their product.
